title: Safe-Arrival Return-to-Home Check
dataSources: Daily activity (`eldercare:activity`), fall alerts (`fall:alert`), medication reminders (`medreminder:event`), check-in calls (`checkin:call`), wandering alerts (`wandering:alert`).
app: Elder-care and accessibility telemetry — activity and fall sensors (Apple Watch fall detection, motion mats), medication dispensers, and check-in / video-call logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and smart-home hubs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=wandering:alert
| stats sum(eval(if(event_type="left_safe_zone",1,0))) as departures, sum(eval(if(event_type="returned_home",1,0))) as returns by resident
| eval return_pct=round(100*returns/departures,1)
| sort - return_pct
description: Shows whether departures from a safe zone are consistently paired with a recorded safe return.
value: A clean return-to-home trail reduces uncertainty and makes missing closure events obvious.
implementation: Use `event_type` on wandering alerts to distinguish departures and returns, then compare counts by resident.
visualization: Table of residents with safe-return percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It maps whether trips away from a safe area are being properly closed out when the person comes home.
